ClassifySoundApp.swift:254-269 + 326-394 – Launching `ClassifySoundApp` currently runs `generateGuaranteedUniqueID()` synchronously inside `init`, then immediately calls `Mixpanel.initialize`/`identify`. The ID generator loops through UUID creation, string manipulation and hashing before storing a value, so when the value is absent the entire launch path waits on that work plus the Mixpanel setup. Strategy: keep the stored ID check and fallback as-is, but move the heavy path into a background `Task(priority: .utility)` launched at the end of `init`. Let that task compute the ID off the main thread, then call `Mixpanel.initialize`/`identify` (or guard it) from `await MainActor.run` once the ID is ready. The behavior stays unchanged because the identifier is still written to `UserDefaults` and Mixpanel is still initialized before tracking events fire, but the main thread is no longer blocked by UUID/random/hash churn.

ClassifySoundApp.swift:280-323 (trackAppLaunch/checkAndShowSharePopup) + lines 482-503 – `trackAppLaunch()` is invoked directly inside `onAppear`, doing synchronous `UserDefaults`, `LogManager`, Mixpanel network calls, and a `DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter` that ultimately flips `globalState.showNewsletterRatingView`. That bundle of work risks delaying first-render and keeps Mixpanel I/O on the main thread. Strategy: make `trackAppLaunch()` async (or wrap it) so it can be scheduled in `Task(priority: .utility)` from `.onAppear`, and keep just the UI mutation on the main actor (e.g., `await MainActor.run { checkAndShowSharePopup(...) }`). That way the launch counter, Mixpanel track/people updates, and the 2-second popup flagging run off the main thread, but the `globalState` flip still happens via `MainActor.run`, preserving behavior while trimming the synchronous launch path footprint.
